chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, he raised it, he said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
"Do not throw the game with something that is larger than it."
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for the projectile used in hunting according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the principle of proportionality in hunting, ensuring that the projectile does not exceed the size of the game to facilitate a swift, humane kill. This ruling reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on *ihsan* (excellence) in animal treatment, preventing unnecessary suffering by avoiding projectiles that cause excessive damage or leave the animal to die slowly.
